L0_MLP.hypothesis: L0_MLP fuses two distinct upstream signals: (1) the local token embedding (determines threshold-comparison direction) and (2) L0 attention head outputs (aggregate previous-position context, modulate magnitude). Ablating L0_MLP (r16) collapses all predictions to 0, confirming it is the essential output component; prior context-ablation (r13) showed L0_MLP writes change significantly when L0 attention heads are removed, proving it reads both sources.
